featured_reviews.name: Upmanyu Jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Upmanyu Jha from SummerCon CRCE here. I recently had the opportunity to organize and attend CXO panel 2 discussion at SummerCon CRCE, and was thoroughly impressed by the insights shared by Ritesh Sir. As a panelist, Ritesh Sir provided a wealth of knowledge on the topic at hand (i.e. on Threat Spectrum) and demonstrated a deep understanding of the subject matter. He was articulate, engaging and his responses to the questions posed by the moderator and the audience were well thought out and informative.

Ritesh sir's passion for the subject matter was evident throughout the discussion, and he was able to effectively convey his ideas in a concise and accessible manner. His expertise in the field was clearly demonstrated and I left the panel discussion feeling more informed and inspired.

Overall, I would highly recommend Ritesh as a speaker and expert in his field. His contributions to the CXO panel discussion were invaluable and I look forward to attending future events where he is speaking.

featured_reviews.name: Vedaant
featured_reviews.review_text: Learning under Ritesh Sir was an eye-opening experience. The way he trusted me with real challenges and encouraged me to think beyond the obvious has had a lasting impact. Truly thankful for the guidance and exposure

featured_reviews.name: Nahida Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The online workshop on "Trending Cybercrimes and Prevention" organized by the Nargis Dutt Foundation was highly insightful and well-presented. Ritesh Sir, explained emerging cyber threats in a clear and relatable manner, emphasizing the importance of POV (Pause, Observe, Verify) techniques for online safety. He also highlighted key practices such as “Zero Trust, Then Verify” and the use of two-factor authentication to enhance digital security.
The real-life examples shared made the session both engaging and practical. Overall, it was a truly valuable and enriching experience.
Thank you So much NDF

featured_reviews.name: Komal Totale
featured_reviews.review_text: It was such a pleasure working with Mr. Ritesh Bhatia! He has this amazing ability to simplify even the most complex topics. During our podcast interview, he shared some truly eye-opening insights on AI and cybersecurity. The conversation flowed so naturally—it was informative, engaging, and full of moments that made us think. We genuinely learned a lot and are so thankful for the experience!

featured_reviews.name: Hrudayesh Ahir
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a fantastic experience working with Mr. Ritesh Bhatia on our web development project — everything was delivered as promised and to a high standard. It was also a pleasure having him on our podcast, where he made AI and cybersecurity topics easy to understand and incredibly engaging. Truly insightful and inspiring! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Zaiba Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: I thoroughly enjoyed the workshop organized by the Nargis Dutt Foundation. It was both insightful and informative. The session offered a deeper understanding of the latest cyber threats and equipped us with practical tips to enhance our online safety. I’m truly grateful to the organizers and to Mr. Bhatia for delivering such a valuable and engaging session.
